author: Nintendo of America
description:
MARVEL Cosmic Invasion: The Siege of Castle Doom DLC is available now on Nintendo Switch 2 and Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/marvel-cosmic-invasion-the-siege-of-castle-doom-70050000081968-switch-2/ 

Play as The Invisible Woman and Doctor Doom in MARVEL Cosmic Invasion’s second DLC, featuring an all-new, highly replayable Castle Doom game mode! 

Race against time as the Siege Gauge fills, unlock powerful upgrades, and stop Victor von Doom before he can activate the deadly Cosmic Inductor! 

- Gather Battery Cells and complete challenges to earn defense, damage, or tactical upgrades from a collection of 12 different perks 

- Choose your path through Castle Doom’s winding routes. Then, thoughtfully select buffs to alter your combat abilities and become an unstoppable powerhouse! 

- Whichever path you take and perks you choose, be sure to reach Victor von Doom before the ominous Siege Gauge is full. The castle’s forces grow in power as the gauge fills...
title: MARVEL Cosmic Invasion: The Siege of Castle Doom – DLC Trailer – Nintendo Switch 2
